2024
Author: Bela M. Trivedi
Bench: Bela M. Trivedi

1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction

 (@Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No.4520/2024)
 Sunny Saraff @ Sunny Sarraf A
 Versus
 The State Of Bihar R
 O R D E R
1.
Leave granted.

2. Heard the learned counsels appearing for the parties and perused the material placed on record.
3.

The appellant apprehending his arrest had applied for anticipatory bail before the Trial Court, i.e.,
the learned District & Additional Sessions Judge-I, Lohardaga in connection with Complaint Case No.31(A) of 2014, corresponding to SC/ST Case No.01 of 2020, registered under Sections 498A and 295A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3(x) (xv) of the Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 which rejected the application and the High Court by way of impugned order dated 5-1-2024 confirmed the same.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and the Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the appellant that the appellant is a student and he had given loan to the complainant which the complainant was not ready to repay and as a counter-blast,
the present First Information Report has been lodged against the appellant.
5. The learned counsel for the respondent  State of Bihar has filed the counter affidavit resisting the present appeal.
However, she has fairly submitted that the appellant is cooperating with the investigation.
6. Having regard to the submissions and to the facts and circumstances of the case, we are inclined to allow the present appeal.
